prompt: A clean, straight-on printed WAREHOUSE STOCK SHEET titled 'COMPONENT STORE -- BIN INDEX' with TWO panels. LEFT panel 'ITEM INDEX': 42 item codes, each printed with its home bin, as 'CODE  ->  bin Bn'. RIGHT panel 'BIN MANIFEST': each bin listed with the item codes stored in it. CRITICAL reciprocity: the two panels must agree BOTH ways -- if the item index says an item is in a bin, that bin's manifest must list that exact item code, and every code in a bin's manifest must be an item whose index entry names that bin. In particular item 'CP-215' is in 'bin B8', so bin B8's manifest must include 'CP-215'. Print both panels so every item-to-bin assignment appears identically in the bin manifest. Render it as a slightly warm off-white printed sheet with alternating faint grey shaded rows (zebra striping), a coloured header band and rounded panel corners, like a modern designed template, viewed straight-on.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a warehouse stock sheet with an ITEM index (item -> home bin) and a BIN manifest (bin -> items stored in it). Ignoring artistic quality, does the image DEPICT that? A photo, scan or clean printed page all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is a blank card, plain panel, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_itembin: In the LEFT 'ITEM INDEX' panel, find the row for item code 'CP-215'. Which bin is it assigned to (read the 'bin Bn' printed after the arrow)? Report exactly what is printed, character for character, even if it looks wrong or inconsistent. Do NOT recompute, correct, or round it. Answer with just the bin label.
reference.q_inbin: In the RIGHT 'BIN MANIFEST' panel, find the line whose bin label is B8. Copy out EVERY item code printed on that one line, in the order they are printed, separated by commas. Report exactly what is printed, character for character, even if it looks wrong or inconsistent. Do NOT recompute, correct, or round anything, and do not add any code that is not printed on that line. Answer with the list of item codes and nothing else. If there is no line labelled B8 at all, answer the single word NONE.
